lang.title: amemo language
lang.lead: amemo labels and hints for agents use this language. You can change it later in Settings.

data.title: Where to keep the base
data.lead: The record base and copies of the files records cite live here. You can move it later with a backup.
data.low: Not enough space: {{free}} free, about {{need}} needed. Choose a folder on another drive.
data.notEmpty: The folder already has files. amemo puts its own next to them, but an empty folder is better.
data.ansi: PostgreSQL cannot open this path: it has characters outside the Windows code page. Choose a folder with Latin letters.

docs.title: Documents folder
docs.lead: amemo quotes files from here: standards, calculations, letters. Records point to a page and a line instead of retelling the document.
docs.none: Not chosen — you can set it later in Settings

features.title: Features
features.lead: What amemo can do right after installation.
features.searchNote: Finds records by meaning, not only by words. Always installed: it is part of amemo, the ~250 MB model comes with the program.
features.ocrNote: PDFs without a text layer become quotable. Tick the languages of your documents.

agents.title: Connect agents
agents.lead: amemo becomes the agent's memory: it finds records on a topic and proposes new ones with sources.
agents.claudeNote: Cowork and Claude Code: the amemo server, skills and hooks. At the end the wizard shows where to upload the plugin.
agents.codexNote: The amemo server and instructions in AGENTS.md.

install.title: Installing amemo
install.lead: This takes a few minutes. You can minimize the window.

carousel.label: What amemo does
carousel.sky: All records on one sky: sources, work and objects, and the links between them.
carousel.write: Write in one line: claim, source, page — amemo checks the rest.
carousel.source: The claim beside its source: the quote is highlighted on the real PDF page.
carousel.review: Review: a person confirms or fixes what an agent proposed.
carousel.card: Object card: everything known about a building, a joint or a material.

done.title: amemo is ready
done.find: Find — ask your agent about a topic or search in amemo.
done.write: Write — ask your agent to remember a finding with its source.
done.check: Check — confirm what agents proposed in Review.
done.autostart: Start when I sign in to Windows

starting.title: amemo is starting
starting.lead: Bringing up the base and the service takes a few seconds. The window opens by itself.

failed.title: amemo did not start
failed.lead: The base or the service did not come up. Your records are safe: this is a start-up error, not a data one.

paused.title: amemo is paused
paused.lead: The base and the service were stopped from the tray icon. While amemo is paused, agents cannot see it.
